metadata.intro: Edit the shared catalogue that everyone sees — rename an artist, album or track, replace its artwork, or re-attribute a release to a different artist. These changes are global and permanent (unlike per-library edits). Every change is recorded in the audit log.

labels.empty: No labels yet — they fill in as your catalogue is enriched from MusicBrainz.

home.emptyState: Nothing here yet - pair a library server and your catalogue will appear.

artists.empty: No artists yet - the catalogue may still be syncing.
artists.filtered: {count, plural, one {# of {total} artist} other {# of {total} artists}}

metadata.intro: Edit metadata for this library only. Your changes apply across your views; anything you leave blank keeps the original value. Global catalogue edits live in the admin page.

visualizer.nothingPlaying: Play something to see the visualiser.

appearance.customColourHint: Pick any colour - buttons, highlights and the background tint follow it.

downloads.serverNote: Music libraries themselves are added and organised on your Chordia library server, not here. Saving downloads to a custom folder (with your own path + organisation layout) is coming to the desktop app.

sessions.body: Where you're signed in. Revoke any device you don't recognise.
